question: What is Cut and Sew — and why would I use it?
quickAnswer: Cut and Sew lets you shape knitted fabric by cutting and finishing edges, instead of doing all the shaping on the machine.
bridge: Cutting your knitting for the first time feels a bit like a leap of faith! Start with this simple practice exercise to get a feel for how the fabric behaves before you move on to a real garment.
trySteps: Knit a small swatch: Use a 4" x 4" square in a light-colored yarn so your stitches are easy to see.
Mark your line: Use a contrasting thread or tailor’s chalk to mark exactly where you want to "cut."
Practice the cut: Use your sharpest shears to cut 3/8" away from your line and watch how the stitches react.
